notes.notes:
[h2]NEW CONTENT[/h2]

[*] With Hordes
[/list]
[/list]

[*] Added an indicator of the current game version on the menu screen
[/list]

[h2]MODIFICATIONS (GENERAL)[/h2]

notes.title: Stranded v1.1 on air!
notes.notes:
[h2]NEW CONTENT[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added the weapon [b]SPEAR[/b]
[*] Added the weapon [b]TRAINING SWORD[/b]
[*] Added 3 new types of [b]TREES[/b] to the game
[*] Added a new animation when starting the project
[*] Added an option to skip the game's opening
[*] Added a new terrain layer in the game, the [b]MOUNTAINS[/b]
[*] Added Wooden and Stone stairs (Useful for climbing or descending mountains)
[/list]

[h2]VISUAL MODIFICATIONS[/h2]

[list]
[*] The vignette starts disabled
[*] The character's hand has been modified
[*] Menu screen has been visually modified
[*] Statistics screen has been visually modified
[*] Crafting screen has been visually modified
[*] Settings screen has been visually modified
[*] Replaced the default font of the Game [b]Kaph -> Vinque[/b]
[/list]

[h2]GENERAL MODIFICATIONS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Recipes have been slightly modified
[*] Weapon descriptions have been updated, showing their durability and estimated damage
[*] Mouse rotation works freely even in interface menus, giving a less "jerky" aspect to the camera
[*] If the user has modified the "Full Screen" option, it will be applied from the moment the game starts, and not just when the menu screen is loaded
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Weapon durability now updates when attacking entities
[*] Fixed bugs in entity navigation (Pathfinding)
[/list]

[h2]KNOWN BUGS[/h2]
[b]There are still some visual bugs in the project, especially after the mountains layer has been added, these bugs are being reviewed and fixed by the developer and will soon be removed from the project![/b]

notes.title: UPDATE 1.0.6
notes.notes:
[h1]MAIN CHANGES[/h1]
[b]Added two new enemies that appear from the first wave (Agile/Weak Bat and Slow/Strong Bat)[/b]

[b]Weapons now have "Tiers" (Wood and Stone currently), where each tier has different durability and effects on the weapons[/b]

[b]Two new weapons have been added, the sword (Main hand) and the shield (Off hand)[/b]

[b]New resources (Mushrooms and Pumpkins) have been added that can be consumed to restore health[/b]

[h2]NEW RECIPES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Torch
[*] Sword
[*] Shield
[*] Hood
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXES[/h2]
[b]Fixed a bug where the equipped item would still appear even when the character had died[/b]

[b]Fixed a minor bug with the Settings buttons[/b]

[b]Fixed a bug with interaction on structures[/b]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements (Rebalance Enemies/Character)
notes.notes:
[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]
	- Fixed durability bug for tools (Axe/Hammer).
	- Fixed post-game statistics screen bug.

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS/UPDATES[/h2]
[h3]TRANSLATIONS[/h3]
	- Added missing pt-br/en translations.

[h3]CRAFTING RECIPES[/h3]
	Axe/Hammer Recipe:
	- Old: 10 Stones, 10 Woods
	- New: 20 Stones, 10 Woods [b](50% increase in required materials)[/b]

[h3]ITEMS[/h3]
	Axe/Hammer Durability:
		- Old: 60 hits
		- New: 180 hits [b](300% increase in durability)[/b]

[h3]ENTITY SPAWNING BY TILES[/h3]
	Goblins:
		- Old: 0.2% per undiscovered tile
		- New: 0.125% per undiscovered tile [b](37.5% reduction in spawn chance)[/b]

	Sheep:
		- Old: 0.4% per undiscovered tile
		- New: 0.75% per undiscovered tile [b](187.5% increase in spawn chance)[/b]

[b]*For comparison, 20 + 2 x 12 + 2 (308 tiles) are rendered at runtime. New tiles are rendered as the player explores, while old ones disappear, but remain counted as discovered tiles to prevent the respawn of already instantiated enemies.[/b]

[h3]ENTITY UPDATES:[/h3]
	Player Character:
		- Base Damage:
			- Old: 1
			- New: 2

		- Critical Hit Chance:
			- Old: 1%
			- New: 2%

		- Initial Health:
			- Old: 15
			- New: 25

	Torch Goblin:
		- Damage:
			- Old: 3 ~ 9
			- New: 3 - 7

		- Attack Reload:
			- Old: 0.6s
			- New: 0.9s

		- Movement Speed:
			- Old: 128min ~ 256max
			- New: 128min ~ 224max

	TNT Goblin:
		- Damage:
			- Old: 3 ~ 9
			- New: 2 ~ 5

		- Attack Reload:
			- Old: 2.0s
			- New: 1.5s

		- Movement Speed:
			- Old: 128min ~ 256max
			- New: 156min ~ 224max

	Barrel Goblin:
		- Damage:
			- Old: 16 ~ 27
			- New: 9 ~ 17

		- Movement Speed:
			- Old: 224min ~ 384max
			- New: 192min ~ 288max
